content_sections.heading: ICMR NIHR Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Consultant (Administrative), 1 for Young Professional II (Scientific), 1 for Young Professional II (Admin) and 1 for Young Professional II (Finance & Accounts).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ICMR NIHR Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICMR NIHR to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR NIHR recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the ICMR NIHR recruitment is 11th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the ICMR NIHR recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Consultant and Young Professional posts in the ICMR NIHR recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Young Professional-II (Scientific) post?
faq.answer: For the Young Professional-II (Scientific) post, candidates need to be Post-graduates in Life Sciences/ Pharmacy / Statistics / Social works/ Sociology / BAMS, BSMS, and MD in AYUSH with at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Consultant (Administrative) post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Consultant (Administrative) post is between 40 to 60 years. For retired Government employees, the age limit is relaxed up to 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for all Young Professional-II posts (Scientific, Admin, and Finance & Accounts) is Rs. 42,000/- per month as consolidated remuneration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the Google sheet form as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ICMR NIHR recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application screening, followed by an interview, and document verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for ICMR NIHR recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICMR National Institute of Health Research located?
faq.answer: The ICMR National Institute of Health Research is located in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 273013.

faq.question: Q10. What is the experience required for the Young Professional-II (Finance & Accounts) post?
faq.answer: For the Young Professional-II (Finance & Accounts) post, candidates require a minimum of three years of post-qualification experience in a relevant field or subject.
